verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is built for programmatic, non-interactive browser automation. Its docs describe cloud browser sessions controlled through a WebSocket/CDP endpoint with Playwright or Puppeteer, official SDKs, single-call Scrape/Crawl/Extract/agent APIs, and a CLI (`hx`), so no local or interactive browser is needed. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions setup, secrets handling), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none).
